{{dablink|For other uses of the word "metal," see [[Metal]].}}
The '''metal helmet''' is a ''[[ter'angreal]]'' recovered from the [[Kin's Storeroom]] in [[Ebou Dar]].{{ref/book|8|4}}

==Appearance==
Made much too thin to be used as an actual helmet in battle and twice as heavy as it looks, the ''ter'angreal'' is covered in minute engravings. The metal also has a slick feel, as if it is covered in oil.

==Use==
The metal helmet was made to control another device of some sort, most likely a machine from the [[Age of Legends]] that was lost during the [[Breaking]].{{ref/book|11|15}}
